items.docs: Download all flag configurations for local evaluation. This endpoint returns the full flag configuration including targeting rules, variants, and segment definitions. Useful for bootstrapping client-side local evaluation SDKs with initialFlags or running evaluation in edge environments.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of flags to return.

params.name: cursor
params.description: A cursor for pagination returned from a previous request.

items.docs: Retrieve a list of all feature flags in the project. Returns flag metadata including status, variants, and deployment information.
Create a new feature flag with the specified key, variants, and targeting configuration.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the feature flag.

items.docs: Retrieve a single feature flag by its ID including full configuration details such as deployments, variants, and targeting segments.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the feature flag.

items.docs: Update an existing feature flag's configuration. Only the fields included in the request body are updated.
